title: Presents for the family
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. What present did Mai buy for each person?

script.t: You will hear Mai talking to her friend Paul about presents she bought on holiday.
So, Mai, did you buy lots of presents in Hoi An?
Yes! For my mum, I wanted to get a silk scarf, but she's got so many. So I bought her a lantern for the garden.
Nice. And your dad?
Dad loves coffee, but you can buy that anywhere. I found a little wooden boat for his desk. He collects them.
What about your brother?
He's always cold, so I got him a jacket. Well, it was a T-shirt at first, but the jacket was cheaper in the end!
Ha! And your grandmother?
She gave me a list! She wanted some tea from the old market, so that was easy.
And did you buy something for yourself?
Just a hat. I saw some beautiful paintings, but they were too expensive. And the silk scarves were lovely, so I bought one for my aunt.

ev.s: So I bought her a lantern for the garden.

items.why: Mai mua đèn lồng cho mẹ để treo trong vườn.

wrong.E: Mai định mua khăn lụa nhưng mẹ đã có nhiều.

ev.s: I found a little wooden boat for his desk.

items.why: Bố được con thuyền gỗ nhỏ để bàn.

wrong.H: Bố thích cà phê, nhưng Mai không mua vì ở đâu cũng có.
wrong.D: Tranh quá đắt nên Mai không mua.

ev.s: so I got him a jacket

items.why: Em trai được áo khoác.

wrong.F: Ban đầu là áo phông, nhưng cuối cùng Mai mua áo khoác.
wrong.A: Mũ là thứ Mai mua cho mình.

ev.s: She wanted some tea from the old market

items.why: Bà muốn trà ở chợ cũ.

wrong.C: Đèn lồng là quà cho mẹ.

ev.s: so I bought one for my aunt

items.why: Mai mua một chiếc khăn lụa cho dì.

title: Jobs at the school fair
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. What job will each person do at the school fair?

script.t: You will hear a teacher, Mr Long, talking to a student, Hana, about the school fair.
Hana, can you help me plan who does what at the fair on Saturday?
Sure. Lan wants to sell cakes. She's a great cook.
Actually, Lan's mother is bringing the cakes. Lan can take photos. She's got a good camera.
OK. What about Duc?
Duc is very tall, so he can put up the signs. I'll stand at the gate myself.
And Vy? She's good at maths.
Yes, she can take the money for the tickets. Who can play music?
Nam has a guitar, but he's shy. Kim plays in a band. She can do the music.
Good. Then Nam can help me clean up at the end. He's always happy to help.
And me?
You can sell the cakes with Lan's mum.

ev.s: Lan can take photos.

items.why: Lan sẽ chụp ảnh vì có máy ảnh tốt.

wrong.D: Lan muốn bán bánh, nhưng mẹ Lan mang bánh và Hana bán.
wrong.G: Lan nấu ăn giỏi nhưng không được giao việc nấu.

ev.s: Duc is very tall, so he can put up the signs.

items.why: Duc cao nên dựng biển chỉ dẫn.

wrong.H: Thầy Long tự đứng ở cổng.
wrong.A: Dọn dẹp là việc của Nam.

ev.s: she can take the money for the tickets

items.why: Vy giỏi toán nên thu tiền vé.

wrong.D: Bán bánh là việc của Hana.
wrong.B: Âm nhạc là việc của Kim.

ev.s: Kim plays in a band. She can do the music.

items.why: Kim chơi trong ban nhạc, phụ trách âm nhạc.

wrong.A: Dọn dẹp là việc của Nam.
wrong.C: Chụp ảnh là việc của Lan.

ev.s: Then Nam can help me clean up at the end.

items.why: Nam giúp thầy dọn dẹp lúc cuối.

wrong.B: Nam có ghi-ta nhưng ngại, nên Kim lo âm nhạc.
wrong.H: Thầy Long tự đứng ở cổng.

title: Holiday plans
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. Where will each person go on holiday?

script.t: You will hear Josh talking to his friend Ha about holiday plans.
Is everyone in your family going away this summer, Josh?
Yes, but not together! My sister's going to the mountains with her school. She wanted to go to the beach, but the school chose the mountains.
And your parents?
They're going to visit my grandparents on their farm. They do that every year.
What about your brother? Is he still at university?
Yes, he's going to stay in the city to work in a cafe. He needs money for next year.
And you?
I'm going to an island with my best friend's family. We're going camping. My cousin Mike wanted to come too, but he's going to a sports camp by a lake.
That sounds fun. My plans are boring. I'm staying at home.

ev.s: My sister's going to the mountains with her school.

items.why: Chị gái đi núi với trường.

wrong.A: Chị muốn đi biển nhưng trường chọn núi.

ev.s: They're going to visit my grandparents on their farm.

items.why: Bố mẹ về trang trại của ông bà.

wrong.B: Thành phố là chỗ anh trai ở lại làm việc.

ev.s: he's going to stay in the city to work in a cafe

items.why: Anh trai ở lại thành phố làm ở quán cà phê.

wrong.C: Trang trại là nơi bố mẹ đi.
wrong.H: Anh không về nhà, mà ở lại thành phố.

ev.s: I'm going to an island with my best friend's family.

items.why: Josh ra đảo cắm trại với gia đình bạn thân.

wrong.E: Hồ là chỗ trại thể thao của Mike.
wrong.A: Không ai trong nhà Josh đi biển.

ev.s: he's going to a sports camp by a lake

items.why: Mike đi trại thể thao bên hồ.

wrong.D: Mike muốn đi đảo cùng Josh nhưng không đi.
wrong.F: Núi là chỗ chị gái Josh đi.

title: Favourite sports
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. Which sport does each person do now?

script.t: You will hear Ly talking to her friend Sam about sports their friends do.
Ly, does Tuan still play football?
No, he hurt his knee. He swims now. The doctor said it's good for his knee.
And Mai? Is she still in the volleyball team?
She left the team last year. She does yoga now, every morning before school.
What about Phong? He loved basketball.
He still loves watching it, but he doesn't play any more. He plays tennis now, because his new school has great courts.
And Thao?
Thao goes running in the park. She wants to run a race in December. She tried cycling, but she didn't like it.
And you, Ly?
Me? I go to a dance class on Saturdays. It's the only sport I really enjoy!

ev.s: He swims now.

items.why: Tuấn đau đầu gối nên giờ đi bơi.

wrong.D: Tuấn thôi đá bóng vì đau đầu gối.
wrong.E: Chạy bộ là môn của Thảo.

ev.s: She does yoga now

items.why: Mai tập yoga mỗi sáng.

wrong.A: Bóng rổ là môn Phong từng thích.

ev.s: He plays tennis now

items.why: Phong giờ chơi tennis nhiều hơn bóng rổ.

wrong.A: Phong chỉ còn thích xem bóng rổ, không chơi nữa.

ev.s: Thao goes running in the park.

items.why: Thảo chạy bộ ở công viên.

wrong.B: Thảo thử đạp xe nhưng không thích.

ev.s: I go to a dance class on Saturdays.

items.why: Ly học nhảy vào thứ Bảy.

title: Days of the week
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. On which day will each person help at the animal centre?

script.t: You will hear a woman, Mrs Binh, talking to a young man, Kevin, about volunteers at an animal centre.
Mrs Binh, I've got the list of volunteers for next week. Can we check the days?
Of course. Let's start with Hoa.
Hoa wanted Monday, but she has a class then. So she'll come on Tuesday.
Fine. And Peter?
Peter works during the week, so he's coming on Saturday. He'd like Sunday, but we're closed then.
Right. What about Linh?
Linh can come on Wednesday or Thursday. I put her on Thursday, because Quang is coming on Wednesday.
Good. And Quang is the one who's studying to be a vet, isn't he?
Yes. And the last one is Mia. She's free on Friday, so that's easy.
And what about Monday? We need someone on Monday.
I'll do Monday myself.

ev.s: So she'll come on Tuesday.

items.why: Hoa đến vào thứ Ba.

wrong.A: Hoa muốn thứ Hai nhưng có lớp học.
wrong.E: Thứ Sáu là ngày của Mia.

ev.s: he's coming on Saturday

items.why: Peter đến thứ Bảy.

wrong.G: Peter muốn Chủ nhật nhưng hôm đó đóng cửa.

ev.s: I put her on Thursday

items.why: Linh được xếp thứ Năm.

wrong.C: Linh rảnh thứ Tư nhưng thứ Tư là của Quang.
wrong.B: Thứ Ba là ngày của Hoa.

ev.s: because Quang is coming on Wednesday

items.why: Quang đến thứ Tư.

wrong.D: Thứ Năm là ngày của Linh.

ev.s: She's free on Friday

items.why: Mia rảnh thứ Sáu.

wrong.F: Thứ Bảy là ngày của Peter.

title: Food for the picnic
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. What will each person bring to the picnic?

script.t: You will hear Anh talking to her friend Chris about a class picnic.
Anh, is everything ready for the picnic on Sunday?
Almost. Let me check. Bao said he'd bring sandwiches, but his mum is making a big salad, so he's bringing that.
Great. And Lily?
Lily has a fruit tree in her garden, so she's bringing mangoes.
What about Tri? He makes good cakes.
He's very busy this week, so he's just bringing drinks. Orange juice and water.
OK. And Vy?
Vy's going to make sandwiches. She asked me if cheese is OK.
And Hung? Is he coming?
Yes! He's bringing ice cream in a cool box. And I'm bringing the cake. Can you bring some plates?
Sure.

ev.s: so he's bringing that

items.why: Mẹ Bảo làm món salad lớn nên Bảo mang salad.

wrong.G: Bảo định mang bánh mì kẹp nhưng đổi sang salad.

ev.s: she's bringing mangoes

items.why: Lily mang xoài từ cây trong vườn.

ev.s: so he's just bringing drinks

items.why: Trí bận nên chỉ mang đồ uống.

wrong.A: Trí làm bánh giỏi nhưng tuần này bận.

ev.s: Vy's going to make sandwiches.

items.why: Vy làm bánh mì kẹp.

wrong.H: Phô mai chỉ là nhân bánh Vy hỏi ý.

ev.s: He's bringing ice cream in a cool box.

items.why: Hùng mang kem trong thùng giữ lạnh.
